npc:10378.text: Where can I send you today $c?

npc:3387.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

npc:3704.text: Your knowledge is great, traveler. You must learn from one who is wiser than I. Many tales have been told of the wisdom of Josef Gregorian. You may find him in Undercity.

npc:4568.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead $c trainer, and you're a $c.

npc:5883.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

npc:3446.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...

progress.text: Did you get the horns, $N?  Those things are going to make me a fortune!

accept.text:
The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters.  Great is his strength, and solemn his pride.  The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.

But I do not fear him.  I am grateful he is here.  He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.

If you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.

His spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.

complete.text:
You now are one with Isha Awak, $N.  His spirit is with you.  He lurks in your eyes...

Eyes that, one day, will learn to see.

objectives.text: Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.

accept.text:
You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens.  Your spirit is strong.  But a hunter must always be prepared.  A true hunter can stalk prey down any path.  Mountains and swamps will not sway her.

Not even the sea.

Find my sister, Mahren.  She hunts the great water beasts along the coast.  She will be your teacher in their ways.

But be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.

complete.text:
My brother sent you, did he?  Then you must have proven yourself to him.  If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.

Are you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?

This fang is merely a token, but what it represents is profound.

Ishamuhale's strength is in you, $N.  May you use it with temperance.  That is your burden.

That is your honor.

accept.text:
Now, $N, you must face the great thunder lizards.  So large are the beasts, the ground rumbles as they stomp across the plains.  Take care as you fight them, for one false step and you may find yourself beneath their feet.

You will find the thunder lizards in the southern Barrens.  They are known as Stormsnouts, Stormhides and Thunderheads.  Return to me after you have bested them.

complete.text: It is good to see you return with proof of victory.  And it is good to know you have done so with your bones unbroken.

objectives.text: Bring 3 Thunder Lizard Blood to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

accept.text:
The thunderhawk, $N, is a fierce beast.  It is time for you to face them.  You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.

Do this, and your time with me will near its end.

complete.text:
You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud.  You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.

But your path, $N, continues.  In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.

Now, it is time to move on.

objectives.text: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?

accept.text:
Your strength impresses me, $c.  Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... and bigger challenges.

The forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually.  If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post.  The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.

objectives.text: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
